text: The paper reports that, for individual human accuracy, the best model results beat unassisted humans (66% vs 57% on MMLU, 67% vs 49% on QuALITY) and model-assisted humans beat the best model results (75% vs 66% on MMLU, 77% vs 67% on QuALITY), with every participant above 71% individual accuracy in the model-assisted condition on both tasks.
title: Model-assisted humans beat both best model and unassisted humans (individual accuracy)
